entities.name: Tavoot's farm
entities.description: A solitary simsass fruit homestead on the Mercadian plains where the Weatherlight crash landed.

entities.name: Atalla
entities.description: Tavoot's 10-year-old son who stowed away to Mercadia City and staged rescues.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Skyship that crash landed at the farm.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: Denied Atalla a place in the crew.

entities.name: Cho-Arrim
entities.description: Used water magic to steal the ship away.

entities.name: Mercadia City
entities.description: City whose soldiers came to arrest the crew.

events.summary: In 4205 the Skyship Weatherlight crash lands on Tavoot's farm; Tavoot and Atalla give the crew information.
events.quote: became the site of the crash landing of the Skyship Weatherlight

events.summary: Gerrard denies Atalla a place on the crew due to his age.
events.quote: was denied the opportunity to join the crew by Gerrard Capashen due to his young age

events.summary: The Cho-Arrim steal the ship with water magic and Mercadia City soldiers arrive to arrest the crew; Atalla stows away.
events.quote: the Cho-Arrim used water magic to steal the ship away

events.summary: Atalla stages two rescues of the crew in the city, earning 2,000 gold for the farm.
events.quote: he staged rescue operations of the crew twice

relations.quote: who lives there with his young son, Atalla
